lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters exhibit a dense, stochastic arrangement on the cephalic region, transitioning to a more structured grid-like alignment posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of white blobs to create a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes on the visible mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal features are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense cluster of small, low-luminance elongated objects (schooling fish) is localized around the ventral and anterior regions of the subject.
